title: Engineering model conformance
description: Interpret engineering content under its declared metamodel and determine explicit structural findings without substituting them for engineering judgment.
responsibilities: Interpret the profile declared by a selected model state, including typed identities and authoritative references.
Check explicit identity presence and uniqueness over an identified candidate scope.
Diagnose rule violations and prepare explicit migration candidates while preserving source-state meaning.
owned_state: The interpretation and checking rules applicable to a declared profile, plus transient findings and migration candidates. Stored profile documents retain their own identities and content custody.

includes: Declared-profile interpretation, identity checking, model conformance, and preparation of migration candidates.
excludes: Content retention, implicit migration, approval, satisfaction judgments, or unqualified validity claims over unavailable scope.

design_limits: IF-002 covers interpretation and identity checking needed by IR-001, including the shared SR-012 obligation. General conformance and migration interactions for FUNC-013 and FUNC-014 are deferred.
The pilot supplies state-scoped raw content and the declared profile to the interpreter. It does not require interpreted retrieval from storage to bootstrap that same interpretation.

sources.basis: Analyst-proposed responsibility boundary derived from the existing Function landscape. Assigned Functions remain authoritative for behavior; this record describes target architecture, not observed implementation.
